title: The cards get their own view under Check in, and the Space's cards get My card's on/off switches
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22: move the Card section to its own sub menu item under Check in, with the same controls as the Crew card. Menu nesting is one level (ADR-846), so Check in gains an in-page view bar (`?view=door` default, `?view=card` labelled Cards), the pattern Membership uses. The Cards view holds the viewer's one Crew card (MyCardSection, from #3860) and the Space's own card; the door view no longer mounts either. The Space's registered cards render through the shared MyCardsList with a spaceId, so each has the same on/off switch; setSpaceCardOn writes behind the loyalty owner gate, scoped by face_space_id. Follows LIVE-1282 and ADR-1874; no migration.
